Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Hon’ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Mr. Parikshit Saini, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Pankaj Joshi, A.G.A. for the State.
At the very outset, learned counsel for 
the appellant submits that the instant appeal 
is preferred against the judgment and order 
dated 06.08.2025, passed in Sessions Trial 
No.135 of 2019, State Vs. Anees, by the court 
of I Additional Sessions Judge, Roorkee, 
District Haridwar.
He submits that by the common 
judgment, another Sessions Trial No. 64 of 
2017, State vs. Anees, was also decided, 
against which CRLA No.590 of 2025 was 
preferred, which is listed before the Single 
Bench.
Against a common judgment, if two 
appeals arise, they may not be listed before 
different Benches. Therefore, Registry may 
seek directions so that both these appeals 
may be listed before one and the same 
Bench. 
(Siddhartha Sah J.) (Ravindra Maithani J.) 
 10.03.2026
RV

01.04.2026 CRLA No.615 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Hon’ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Ms. Sukhwani Singh, learned counsel holding 
brief of Mr. Parikshit Saini, learned counsel for the 
appellant. 
2. Mr. Pankaj Joshi, learned AGA for the State. 
3. On 10.03.2026, this Court requested the 
Registry to seek directions so that CRLA No. 615 of 
2025 and CRLA No. 590 of 2025 may be listed 
before the same Bench. It appears that the Registry 
forgot to take note of the Court’s order. In fact, 
multiple instances have been reported where such 
negligence on the part of the Registry has been 
recorded.
4. The Registrar General shall look into the 
matter and direct the Registrar (Judicial) to seek 
instructions for listing both appeals before the same 
Bench.
(Siddhartha Sah, J.) (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 01.04.2026
